clue.text: Articles about Ark drifting, attaining Turkish location

indicators.note: a boat drifting has lost its set course, so the word Ark is moved out of order
about means around, so the articles are wrapped round the jumbled boat

parts.note: the indefinite articles an and a, split to go round

explanation.surface: Noah's Ark drifts on the floodwaters until it comes to rest somewhere in Turkey, as Mount Ararat lies there.
explanation.walkthrough: The two articles are AN and A, one either side.
explanation.definitionFit: Ankara is the capital city of Turkey, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: Close hand, taking up end of line in the dark

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the combined letters are read from bottom to top
the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone holds a hand close while taking in the last line in the dark.
explanation.walkthrough: MITT takes on the E, and that pair is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark is the period after sunset, so it is the hours of night.

clue.text: Host barring Republican woman

indicators.note: barring means excluding, so the letter for Republican is left out

parts.note: a host is a great crowd, like an army

explanation.surface: A host turns away a Republican woman from a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Amy is a female given name, which crosswords allow to be clued as a woman.

clue.text: US President, father and son? A mother and son, rather

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother

explanation.surface: A US President was both a father and a son of presidents, the clue adding that a mother and son are involved instead.
explanation.walkthrough: John Adams and his son John Quincy Adams were both US Presidents, hence 'father and son'.
explanation.definitionFit: Adams is the surname shared by the second and sixth US Presidents, a father and his son.

clue.text: Suspended expression of surprise about name with a history

indicators.note: about means around, so the exclamation is placed round the following letter

parts.note: something with a long past is old

explanation.surface: Someone is suspended from a post and reacts with surprise to a name that has a past.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan or call that is on hold has been suspended or paused for the time being.

clue.text: Reformulated one graph about a home for poor children

indicators.note: reformulated means made up again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A statistician redraws a chart about a care home for needy children.
explanation.definitionFit: An orphanage is an institution that houses and raises children without parents, often poor ones.

clue.text: Lead character in story having no love for a woman

indicators.note: having none of something means it is taken out of the word

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A story's protagonist feels no love for a particular woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Her is the pronoun used to refer to a woman, and informally 'a her' is a female.

clue.text: Language? Set it up in computer network

indicators.note: in means placed inside the next piece
in a down clue, set up means the word it is turned to read upwards

explanation.surface: Someone asks which programming language to use when setting up a computer network.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin is the language of ancient Rome, so it is one example of a language.

clue.text: Difficulty surrounding start of game leading to variable game

indicators.note: leading to puts the preceding letters first, followed by the next piece
surrounding means placed all round the next item

parts.note: as in 'there's the rub', a snag or obstacle

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter only

parts.note: algebra uses x, y and z for variables

explanation.surface: A tricky moment at the start of one match turns into a game whose result is uncertain.
explanation.walkthrough: RUB goes round G, then Y follows. The clue uses 'game' twice: first for its initial letter, then as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rugby is a team sport played with an oval ball, so it is an example of a game.

clue.text: Puzzle regarding police raid finishing early

indicators.note: finishing early means stopping before the end, so the final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a police raid that ended sooner than planned.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebus is a picture puzzle where images and letters stand for words or syllables.

clue.text: Kit one used in a piano piece (American)

indicators.note: a thing used in something else is put inside it

parts.note: a part is a piece of something
a means one, as in a single item

explanation.surface: An American pianist uses a single piece of kit during a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is the article A in its sense of a single thing, and it sits inside the word for piece; the piano is the musical P for soft.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparatus is the equipment or gear needed for a job, the same sense as kit.

clue.text: Small shifts in wood and field

indicators.note: the letter for small moves to a new place inside the word, reordering it

parts.note: a copse is a small wood

explanation.surface: Small changes take place in a wood and the field next to it.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the S (small) moves: it goes from fourth place in COPSE to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Scope is the range or area covered by something, as is a field of study or activity.

clue.text: Cricketer encountering a lot of bowling in part of south London

indicators.note: a lot of a thing is most but not all of it, so the final letter goes

parts.note: seam bowling is a fast style that makes the ball move off its stitching

explanation.surface: A batsman has to face a long spell of bowling during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: Seam bowling is a cricket style; drop its last letter. Battersea is a district of south London beside the Thames, home to a famous power station.
explanation.definitionFit: Battersea is a district on the south bank of the Thames within the London borough of Wandsworth.

clue.text: Call? Not initially benign when receiving it

indicators.note: receiving means taking something in, so the next word goes inside
not initially means without the opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a call that is not, at first, friendly when it is received.
explanation.definitionFit: To entitle something is to give it a title or name, which is one sense of call.

clue.text: Contributor to paper on doubtful concerto movement?

indicators.note: the run of words contributes some of its letters, which hide the answer

parts.note: the end of paper, all of on, the start of doubtful

explanation.surface: A newspaper writer is unsure about reviewing a concerto.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a rondo is one example of a concerto movement, often the finale.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo, with its recurring main theme, is the usual form for the last movement of a classical concerto.

clue.text: Ready to receive East German response

indicators.note: receiving something means taking it inside, so the next word goes within

parts.note: ripe means ready, as fruit is
Ost is the German word for east

explanation.surface: Someone stands ready to receive an East German's reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A riposte is a quick sharp reply, so it is a kind of response or retort.

clue.text: USA going wild with this Japanese treatment

indicators.note: running wild means out of control, so the letters are scattered

explanation.surface: Americans have gone wild for this massage therapy from Japan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This' is part of the letters, and also points to the answer itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiatsu is a form of finger-pressure massage therapy developed in Japan.

clue.text: Sick, weak, powerless, eating toast

indicators.note: eating means taking something inside, so the next word goes within
powerless means without power, so the letter standing for power is removed

explanation.surface: An invalid is sick and too weak to eat anything more than toast.
explanation.walkthrough: P is the physics symbol for power, so PUNY loses it. 'Your health!' is a toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Unhealthy means not in good health, which is to say ill or sick.

clue.text: Authorise secretary to return test

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the letters for secretary are read right to left

parts.note: to prove something is to test it, as in proving ground

explanation.surface: A boss authorises an assistant to come back and take an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: To approve a plan is to sanction or officially permit it to go ahead.

clue.text: Indifferent of US bankers to imprison worker

indicators.note: imprisoning someone puts them inside, so the bankers enclose the next word

parts.note: the Fed is the US Federal Reserve, the central bank
a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: American bankers callously lock up an employee.
explanation.definitionFit: Offhanded means casual and uninterested in manner, so it is an equivalent of indifferent.

clue.text: Dislike retreating when chasing revolutionary predator

indicators.note: chasing means following behind, so this piece comes after the next one

parts.note: Che Guevara, the crossword's stock revolutionary

indicators.note: something retreating goes backwards, so the word is read right to left

explanation.surface: A revolutionary dislikes having to retreat while hunting a dangerous beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The cheetah is a big cat that hunts antelope, so it is a predator.

clue.text: Rib, hot, supplied in diner

indicators.note: something supplied in a place is put inside it

parts.note: British slang for a cheap café

explanation.surface: A hot spare rib is served in a diner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rib' looks like a cut of meat on a menu but is the verb to tease. A caff is a British greasy-spoon café.
explanation.definitionFit: To chaff someone is to tease them good-naturedly, which is the same as to rib them.

clue.text: Each re-evaluation of fuel's making things simpler

indicators.note: a re-evaluation looks again and reworks the letters into a new order

parts.note: the letters of fuel plus the s, rearranged

explanation.surface: An economist reassesses fuel prices, saying it makes life simpler for each household.
explanation.definitionFit: Easeful means bringing ease or comfort, so it describes things being made less hard.

clue.text: Information on a crime heard on radio in city

indicators.note: radio is listened to rather than seen, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: leads are clues pointing detectives towards a culprit

explanation.surface: A radio news bulletin asks the public for information about a crime in a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeds is a large city in West Yorkshire in northern England.

clue.text: A lot of people in attendance for jewellery item

parts.note: a gate is the number of spectators at a sporting event

explanation.surface: A large crowd turns up to view a jewellery display.
explanation.walkthrough: In British sport the 'gate' is the attendance figure at a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Agate is a banded semi-precious stone often cut and set in brooches or rings.

clue.text: Gold bar I dropped, judging by the sound

indicators.note: dropped means let go, so that letter is taken out

parts.note: the letter removed from the bar

explanation.surface: Someone drops a gold bar and can tell from the noise what it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Aural means relating to the ear or hearing, so a judgement made aurally is made by hearing.

clue.text: Gregory will probe the preceding total

indicators.note: a probe goes inside something, so this name is placed within the other piece

parts.note: the answer to the previous across clue
short form of the name Gregory

explanation.surface: Gregory will investigate the previous total figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The preceding' is a cross-reference: it means the answer to the clue just before, 21 across.
explanation.definitionFit: An aggregate is a whole formed by combining several elements, so it means a sum or total.

clue.text: Spirit that is taken after dope

indicators.note: taken after means placed following, so these letters come second

explanation.surface: A spirit is drunk after taking drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dope' suggests drugs, but it means inside information, as does GEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A genie is a spirit of Arabian folklore, like the one in Aladdin's lamp.

clue.text: Do without clear backing, being unregarded

parts.note: to forgo is to go without

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so this word is read right to left

parts.note: nett means clear of deductions, as in clear profit

explanation.surface: Someone manages without the clear support of others and is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forgotten is no longer remembered or paid attention to, so it is overlooked or neglected.

clue.text: Personal evidence of discomfort when meeting Nationalist

explanation.surface: A personal sign of unease when coming face to face with a nationalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Own as an adjective means belonging to oneself, which is to say private or personal.

clue.text: A note of Escoffier's range

parts.note: N is a dictionary abbreviation for note
Escoffier was a French chef, and des is French for of the

explanation.surface: A recipe note from the great French chef Escoffier, perhaps about his kitchen range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Range' looks like a cooker beside a chef's name, but it is a mountain range.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andes are the long mountain range running down the western side of South America.

clue.text: Worried friend's failing to get married

indicators.note: failing to get something means going without it, so that letter is missing

parts.note: a mate is a friend; the 's is short for is

explanation.surface: A friend is anxious about not managing to get married.
explanation.definitionFit: Ate, as in 'what's eating you?', means troubled or gnawed at, so it can mean worried.

clue.text: Enough work to engage Tolkien character

indicators.note: to engage is to take on or hold, so this word holds the next one inside it

parts.note: to ply a trade is to work at it
an Ent is a tree-like giant in The Lord of the Rings

explanation.surface: There is enough work to keep a hobbit or wizard occupied.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenty means a sufficient or ample amount, so as a pronoun it can replace enough.

clue.text: Corrects English manuscript, including last part

indicators.note: including means holding inside, so the manuscript letters go round the next piece

parts.note: the end is the final part

explanation.surface: An editor corrects an English manuscript, including its final section.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct or revise it, removing errors.
